finding.root_cause: Identity v2 hashed selected config, weight, and tokenizer files while accepting a caller-supplied model ID. The planned SentenceTransformer load path permits trust_remote_code and can consume modules.json, nested sentence-transformers configuration, and local Python files that v2 did not bind.
finding.impact: The resource-blocked zero-call receipt remains truthful, but identity v2 must not authorize a later 4B attempt on a suitable GPU because executable code or configuration could drift without changing the recorded identity.
required_successor: bind an immutable acquisition manifest and resolved 40-hex commit revision
require the manifest model ID to equal the preregistered expected model ID
bind the exact recursive closure of every regular file consumed from the local model directory, including remote code and nested configuration
fail closed on any missing, extra, size-mismatched, or digest-mismatched file

secondary_finding.impact: No COST or hidden reference was loaded by the zero-call preflight, but the executable preregistration contained a historical COST-derived diagnostic while claiming all COST reference access was forbidden.
secondary_finding.required_successor: Remove the COST-derived diagnostic from executable program inputs and keep COST, hidden, frozen, and holdout references unavailable to the challenger attempt.
